Now, Warriors fans all over the country wish they could have been in that building when they won that title. Hundreds of fans were turned away at the gate this year for the NBA finals, because unbeknownst to them they had fake tickets. so we're looking at this as a big problem. Well, today, thanks to our solution, built on the blockchain, they can.
